experiences.title: Engineering Intern, Harbor Ticketing
experiences.description: Implemented ASP.NET Core endpoints for reserving seats at six small venues, using Entity Framework Core transactions against SQL Server. Added xUnit tests for expired holds and simultaneous checkout requests.
experiences.outcome: The revised hold path prevented overselling in the team's 500-request load test.

experiences.title: Box Office Notification Worker
experiences.description: Wrote a C# worker that consumed RabbitMQ messages after ticket purchases and rendered venue-specific confirmation templates. Configured dead-letter queues for invalid payloads and added correlation identifiers to Serilog entries.
experiences.outcome: Support staff could trace failed confirmations from purchase to dead-letter record using one identifier.

experiences.title: Dorm Tool Lending API
experiences.description: Built a .NET Minimal API for tracking forty shared tools, with SQLite persistence and Swagger documentation. Used optimistic concurrency tokens to reject returns made from stale browser tabs.
experiences.outcome: Eight residents used the service for a month and recorded 73 loans.

experiences.title: Data Structures Portfolio
experiences.description: Implemented hash tables, AVL trees, and priority queues in C# without collection-library equivalents. Benchmarked lookup behavior on randomized inputs and explained collision strategies in a written analysis.
